properties.title: NRC Report: Unknown Oil in Port Canaveral near Port Canaveral, FL
properties.summary: Incident Type: UNKNOWN SHEEN - NRC Report ID: 970095 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party: ROYAL CARIBBEAN INTERNATIONAL
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 970095
Incident Time: 2011-03-14 14:00:00
Nearest City: Port Canaveral, FL
Incident Type: UNKNOWN SHEEN
Material: UNKNOWN OIL
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: ROYAL CARIBBEAN INTERNATIONAL
Skytruth Analysis
ON FRIDAY MARCH 11, 2011 (AT APPROXIMATELY 1545) WHILE ALONGSIDE IN PORT CANAVERAL (PIER 10) THE MONARCH OF THE SEAS RELEASED 1 X YAMAHA 4-STOKE 6HP OUTBOARD ENGINE INTO THE WATER. THE MENTIONED ENGINE WAS ATTACHED TO THE 14 FOOT PAINT RAFT BEING HAULED BY CRANE TO BE SECURED BACK ON DECK 5 FWD MOORING DECK. THE RAFT GOT CAUGHT UNDER THE PIER AND WHEN FURTHER HAULING COMMENCED THE ENGINE RIPPED OFF FALLING INTO THE WATER. PORT AGENT WAS INFORMED AND CONTACTED THE LOCAL HARBORMASTER. ON MONDAY MARCH 14, 2011 2 X DIVERS RECOVERED THE ENGINE SAFELY BACK ONTO THE PIER. THERE WAS NO ENVIRONMENTAL HAZARDS DISCHARGED INTO THE WATER AS THE GAS TANK WAS STILL CONNECTED ONBOARD THE PAINT RAFT WHEN THE ENGINE BECAME DISLODGED. THERE WAS A SMALL SHEEN OBSERVED FROM THE ENGINE WHEN IT REACHED THE SURFACE BUT QUICKLY DISSIPATED. PORT AGENT INFORMED THAT THE RECOVERY WAS COMPLETE.
